```tok
tok 1.0 "IT solution request process"

pool org "Organization"
  lane requester "Requester"
    start start_req "Process start"
    task submit_req "Submit request for IT solution"
    end end_reject "Request rejected"

  lane it "IT"
    task assess "Assess the request"
    xor approved "Request approved?"
    task procure "Procure tools or licenses"
    task install "Install the solution"
    task test "Test the solution in controlled environment"
    task rollout "Roll out the solution to requesting department"
    xor training_needed "Training needed?"
    task train "Provide training"
    task support "Provide IT support"
    end end_complete "Process complete"

flow start_req -> submit_req
flow submit_req -> assess
flow assess -> approved
flow approved -> procure "yes"
flow approved -> end_reject "no"
flow procure -> install
flow install -> test
flow test -> rollout
flow rollout -> training_needed
flow training_needed -> train "yes"
flow training_needed -> support "no"
flow train -> support
flow support -> end_complete
```
